Grout in the shower going grey-black along the bottom four rows of tiles and in the corner by the tray. Tried bicarb paste and an old toothbrush first: rubbish, 40 min of scrubbing for not much. HG Grout Cleaner concentrate (£8.99, B&Q) diluted 1 part to 3 water, left 10 min, worked in with a stiff grout brush and rinsed: way better, nearly white again. The black spots in the corner came back within a fortnight though, which means it's mould growing in the grout, not dirt on top. So on 7 Dec 2024 raked out the worst 2 metres with a carbide grout rake, hoovered, and regrouted with Mapei Ultracolor Plus 111 silver grey (2kg bag, used about a third). Left it 24h before the shower went back on, then 2 coats of Lithofin grout sealer. Squeegee the tiles after every shower now, it's on a hook. Underlying cause is the steam, see [[Damp in the bathroom]]. Leftover grout is on the shelf in the shed next to the paint from [[Painting the hallway]].
